description: Store the invoices this chat created without an account (the PDFs from finalize_invoice) in the connected facturo account. They keep the user's own invoice numbers and facturo's numbering continues after the highest one. Only call it after the user said yes to the offer, ideally before the first invoice is created in the account so the sequence stays in order. An invoice already in the account is never stored twice.

invoice_numbers.description: Only these numbers (from importable_invoices); default: all of them
